title: pane commands hang forever when the CLI is newer than the running app
notes: Seen 2026-11-02 right after a rebuild, before the app restart: `node "$DASHBOARD_COMMAND" pane list` (and claim, run) hang with no output. $DASHBOARD_COMMAND points into the installed app, so a rebuild swaps the CLI under the still-running old app. Since #196 the CLI ends its request at a newline and waits for the answer without half-closing; the old app waits for the half close, so neither side moves. Fix: the CLI times out (a few seconds) with a line saying the running app is older than the command and needs a restart; the request carries the build stamp so the app can refuse a mismatched CLI as a value (errors-rule-2). Test the timeout with a server that never answers.

comments.body: PR #203. A pane command now gives up after 5 seconds when the app has not taken its request, saying the app is likely older and needs a restart; the request carries the build stamp and the app refuses another build as a value (notify excepted, so worker hooks keep working after a rebuild). The timeout, acceptance and version check are in src/main/workers/app-handshake.ts for the dashboard command card. Needs a rebuild and restart of the installed app.
